title: Product Marketing Manager - Argentina
description: Nuestro equipo de Product Marketing &amp; Lifecycle<br><br>El equipo global de Lifecycle tiene la misión de ayudar a emprendedores a hacer crecer sus negocios, diseñando estrategias que impulsen la activación, retención y lealtad, al mismo tiempo que lidera iniciativas de engagement, comunidad y educación como eventos, programas de formación y experiencias que realmente conecten con nuestra audiencia.<br><br>Estamos buscando una persona para liderar la estrategia de Product Marketing y Lifecycle de Tiendanube en Argentina. Este rol es clave para impulsar el crecimiento y la retención de merchants, asegurando que nuestro posicionamiento, mensajes y estrategias de go-to-market reflejan la madurez del mercado argentino y las particularidades del ecosistema local.<br><br>El tamaño de tu desafío<br><br><ul><li>Liderar el equipo de PMM y Lifecycle Argentina, impulsando el crecimiento, retención y adopción de productos por parte de los merchants;</li><li>Colaborar con los equipos de Brand, Growth Acquisition, Agencies y Sales para alinear la estrategia local con los objetivos globales;</li><li>Actuar como punto de contacto principal para la ejecución local del go-to-market, garantizando coherencia entre marketing, ventas y customer success;</li><li>Traducir lanzamientos y mejoras de producto en estrategias de GTM efectivas y adaptadas al mercado argentino;</li><li>Supervisar las iniciativas de los equipos de PMM Core, PMM Agencies y Lifecycle Education, asegurando posicionamiento consistente y foco en resultados;</li><li>Diseñar y optimizar journeys de CRM y estrategias de nurturing que combinen automatización, IA y contacto humano para maximizar retención y GMV.<br><br></li></ul>Lo que buscamos<br><br><ul><li>Experiencia comprobada en Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing o Growth Strategy, idealmente en empresas SaaS, marketplaces o e-commerce;</li><li>Conocimiento sólido de procesos de go-to-market, journey del cliente y segmentación de merchants (SMB/MM);</li><li>Experiencia liderando equipos multifuncionales e influyendo en áreas como Sales, Brand y Growth;</li><li>Mentalidad analítica, con experiencia trabajando con métricas de adopción, churn y GMV;</li><li>Familiaridad con herramientas de marketing automation, CRM y soluciones de IA aplicadas a lifecycle;</li><li>Resiliencia y adaptabilidad para desenvolverse en contextos dinámicos y de cambio constante.</li><li>Disponibilidad para trabajar con una modalidad híbrida (estamos en Nuñez - CABA).<br><br></li></ul>Es un plus<br><br><ul><li>Portugués conversacional.<br><br></li></ul>Nuestro proceso<br><br>Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.<br><br>Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.<br><br>Lo que te proponemos<br><br><ul><li>Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);</li><li>Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;</li><li>Reintegro del servicio de Internet;</li><li>Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;</li><li>La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;</li><li>Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;</li><li>15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;</li><li>Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;</li><li>Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;</li><li>Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;</li><li>Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.<br><br></li></ul>Política de Privacidad<br><br>Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.<br><br>Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.<br><br>Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description: About The Company At OneClick Code, we are revolutionizing the roofing and restoration industry through smart automation, data transparency, and instant access to critical building information. Our mission is to empower contractors, adjusters, and insurance professionals with accurate, jurisdiction-specific codes and permit data, instantly, so they can work smarter, not harder. Founded in 2018, with a vision to eliminate the inefficiencies and guesswork that slow down claims and repairs, OneClick Code has become the go-to platform for accessing trusted roofing codes, manufacturer specifications, tax jurisdiction data, and permit requirements, all in just one click. We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and impact. As we scale, we're looking for mission-driven team members who are passionate about using technology to bring clarity and confidence to an often-overlooked corner of the construction world. The Opportunity OneClick Data is seeking a Technical Delivery Manager to oversee Agile delivery execution across our Product Engineering, Data Analytics, and Data Acquisition teams. This role is responsible for facilitating Scrum ceremonies, tracking sprint and epic progress, managing delivery risks, coordinating software releases, and providing clear operational visibility to engineering and product leadership. The Technical Delivery Manager serves as the central coordination point across technical teams, ensuring work progresses predictably, dependencies are managed proactively, and stakeholders have accurate insight into delivery status. This role does not own product strategy or backlog prioritization. Priorities are owned by Product Leadership, Engineering Leadership, and functional team leaders. The Technical Delivery Manager focuses on execution, delivery predictability, reporting, risk management, and release readiness. This position requires a strong technical background and the ability to participate effectively in discussions involving software architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and system dependencies. Responsibilities Agile Delivery Management Facilitate Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Tech Grooming, and Sprint Retrospectives across multiple technical teams. Ensure Scrum processes are consistently followed and continuously improved. Monitor sprint execution and team progress throughout each sprint. Track sprint commitments and completion rates. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve delivery predictability and team effectiveness. Sprint Reporting Produce sprint-level reporting including: Sprint progress and completion status Sprint Burn Down metrics Sprint commitment versus completion Team velocity trends Carry-over work Blocked work items Delivery risks and mitigation plans Release Readiness Track work across the following categories: Features Enablers Bugs Provide reporting on: Work item counts Story points Completed work Remaining work Team allocation by work type Epic Reporting Produce Epic status reporting including: Epic Burn Up metrics Epic completion percentage Remaining story points Forecast completion dates Dependency status Risk assessment At-risk and off-track initiatives Maintain visibility into delivery progress across all active Epics and strategic initiatives. Risk and Dependency Management Identify delivery risks early and proactively drive mitigation plans. Track and manage cross-team dependencies. Coordinate resolution of blockers impacting sprint, epic, or release commitments. Escalate issues that threaten delivery timelines or business objectives. Partner with functional leaders to remove obstacles and maintain execution momentum. Release Management Maintain visibility into all work planned for upcoming releases. Coordinate release readiness activities across teams. Track Features, Enablers, and Bugs included in each release. Maintain release dashboards and release status reports. Ensure release planning aligns with company Semantic Versioning (SemVer) standards. Communicate release readiness, risks, and forecasted release dates to stakeholders. Track release scope changes and impacts throughout the development lifecycle. Executive and Leadership Reporting Provide regular reporting to Product & Engineering Leadership including: Delivery forecasts Velocity trends Risk assessments Dependency tracking Team allocation across Features, Enablers, and Bugs Serve as a trusted source of delivery intelligence for leadership decision-making. Technical Environment The Technical Delivery Manager will work closely with teams building and operating solutions using: TypeScript React / Expo AWS Lambda Amazon API Gateway Amazon DynamoDB Serverless architectures JSON APIs CI/CD pipelines Cloud-native application development The successful candidate is not expected to contribute production code but must be able to understand technical discussions, identify technical dependencies, and assess delivery risks across these technologies. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, technical program management, technical project management, delivery management, or related technical leadership roles. 3+ years of experience facilitating Agile and Scrum processes for software development teams. Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycles and release management. Experience working with engineering teams building cloud-native applications. Experience using Jira or similar Agile project management platforms. Strong analytical, reporting, and organizational skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Technical Requirements Candidates Must Be Able To Understand software architecture and system dependencies. Participate effectively in technical planning discussions. Understand APIs, cloud services, data flows, and integration points. Assess delivery risks associated with technical implementations. Communicate effectively with engineers, technical leads, and executive leadership. Understand release planning and Semantic Versioning (SemVer) concepts. Nice-to-Haves Previous experience as a Technical Project Manager, or Technical Program Manager. Experience supporting SaaS platforms. Experience with serverless architectures on AWS. Experience working with distributed engineering teams. Familiarity with data engineering, analytics platforms, or acquisition pipelines. Scrum, Agile, PMP, or related certifications. Success Metrics Success In This Role Will Be Measured By Sprint predictability Epic delivery predictability Release predictability Accuracy and timeliness of reporting Blocker resolution effectiveness Dependency management effectiveness Reduction in delivery surprises Stakeholder confidence in delivery visibility Continuous improvement in Agile delivery processes The ideal candidate combines the technical credibility of a former engineer with the organizational discipline of a delivery leader, enabling teams to execute effectively while providing leadership with clear and actionable insight into delivery progress. Compensation: Salary range for this role is $3,000- $ 3,500 per month, based on experience. Benefits OneClick Code offers generous PTO and 9 paid US company holidays. We provide a reimbursement program to help offset private health insurance expenses. Employees are eligible for up to $125 USD per month in reimbursements for qualifying private health insurance costs. Location: Remote

description: <strong>ERM Program Delivery Manager <br><br></strong>Reports to: Global ERM Program Leader<br><br><strong>Role Summary<br><br></strong>The ERM Program Delivery Manager supports the Global ERM Program Leader in the day-to-day delivery of the Global ERM Program across Regions and Member Firms. The role is responsible for managing defined components of the ERM cycle and helping ensure that the ERM program is delivered consistently, on time, and to a high-quality standard. This includes cycle planning, stakeholder coordination, risk assessment support, submission review, mitigation tracking, governance reporting, and data quality oversight.<br><br>At a tactical level, this role supports day-to-day execution of the ERM cycle, including submission planning and tracking, coordination of risk workshops, review of risk and mitigation content, action follow-up, governance support, data quality oversight, and coordination with technology teams on ERM tools and reporting.<br><br><strong>The opportunity<br><br></strong>Enterprise Risk Management plays an important role in helping the EY Network to proactively change behaviors related to key network risks to safeguard the organization while enabling purposeful growth. This would be done through identifying, assessing, managing, and reporting risk in a structured and consistent way. This role provides the opportunity to work in a dynamic global environment and help operationalize the Global ERM strategy across Regions and Member Firms.<br><br>This is a delivery-focused role with significant responsibility for the practical running of the ERM program. The successful candidate will help drive execution of the annual and periodic ERM cycle, support risk governance activities, strengthen network capability, improve the consistency of local risk assessments, and enhance the quality of management information available to leadership.<br><br><strong>Your key responsibilities:<br><br></strong><strong>ERM program delivery and coordination<br><br></strong><ul><li>Support the Global ERM Program Leader in the day-to-day delivery of the ERM program across Regions and Member Firms.</li><li>Manage agreed elements of the ERM cycle, including planning, milestone tracking, follow-ups, submission management, and status reporting.</li><li>Maintain delivery trackers, action logs, and program dashboards to help ensure activities are completed on time and in line with agreed requirements.</li><li>Proactively follow up with stakeholders on outstanding inputs, actions, and deliverables, and escalate issues as required.</li><li>Coordinate the issuance of timelines, templates, guidance, and communications for each stage of the ERM cycle.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Risk assessment and workshop Custodians.</li><li>Contribute to enhancements in templates, methodology, guidance, and delivery processes.</li><li>Coordinate with Business Analyst / Tech Support resources on user support, data maintenance, analytics, testing, and other program priorities.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Skills And Attributes For Success<br><br></strong><ul><li>Strong understanding of Enterprise Risk Management concepts, risk assessment methodology, and mitigation tracking.</li><li>Strong program delivery and coordination skills, including planning, milestone tracking, issue management, and action follow-up.</li><li>Ability to review and challenge risk and mitigation content with good attention to detail and quality.</li><li>Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills, including preparation of governance materials and management updates.</li><li>Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across a matrixed, global environment.</li><li>A hands-on, delivery-focused mindset with sound judgment, accountability, and a continuous improvement orientation.<br><br></li></ul><strong>To qualify for the role, you must have<br><br></strong><ul><li>Typically 5–8 years of relevant professional experience in Enterprise Risk Management, Operational Risk, Governance, Risk Transformation, or risk-focused program delivery / PMO.</li><li>Hands-on experience supporting risk assessments, workshops, mitigation tracking, governance reporting, submission management, or risk data quality review.</li><li>Experience working title: Senior Product Owner
description: Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Senior Product Owner for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in Argentina. Our client offers a comprehensive suite of billing, payments, and software solutions for professional services firms. You'll drive the day-to-day product work behind Tabs3 and Orion, the practice management platforms that thousands of law firms rely on to run their business. It is a hands-on role that spans the full product lifecycle. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Mid-Market and Enterprise Legal Solutions, you will help define the roadmap and then own the details that turn it into shipped software: researching incoming feature requests, building the case for what to prioritize, writing product requirements documents and user stories, and partnering closely with engineering and design through delivery. When developers hit product or specification questions that block progress, you will work with customers, internal teams, and leadership to quickly determine the right direction and keep development moving. The role combines responsibilities that are often split across product management, product ownership, business analysis, and scrum master. It is well-suited to a candidate who has worked across several of these areas and is comfortable moving between them, weighing priorities with leadership one moment, and defining exactly how a feature should behave the next. Success in this role demands a self-directed professional who pursues the information needed to move work forward rather than waiting for it to arrive. Requirements 5+years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, software consulting, or solution design, with experience across more than one of these areas. Expertise in business analysis with the ability to break down complex problems, determine what to build and why, and define clear requirements. Expertise in writing of requirements: a track record of PRDs, specifications, and user stories with acceptance criteria that engineering teams readily accept. Exceptional communication skills, which are central to this role: be comfortable interviewing and talking with customers, presenting ideas and recommendations clearly to senior leadership, and working closely with engineering and design. Have a proactive, self-directed approach with the ability to actively seek out the information needed to move work forward rather than waiting for it. Be comfortable working with data to support prioritization and to make a defensible case for what to build. Strong critical thinking with the ability to ask the right questions and get to the root of a problem rather than settling for surface-level answers. Detail-oriented and well organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across two products. Working hours that overlap with U.S. Central and Eastern business hours, with Eastern time as the priority (overlap: 8 am till 5 pm EST). Nice To Have Experience with SaaS products, ideally professional services or practice management software. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and backlog management. A working understanding of how software is built, including APIs, databases, and integrations. Experience collaborating with UX/design teams on user experience and interface decisions. Experience supporting and evolving established, mature products alongside newer offerings. Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), ideally in business, information technology, computer science, or a related field. Understanding of AI tools to work more efficiently (e.g., Claude, Figma AI, and similar). Responsibilities Gather and investigate incoming requests from customers, sales, support, and internal teams to understand the underlying problem behind each ask, not just the stated solution. Provide the data and context that drive prioritization decisions, customer impact, frequency, effort, and fit with product strategy, and present clear recommendations to leadership. Translate priorities into clear, thorough requirements that define what a feature does, how it behaves, and the edge cases that matter. Decompose features into well-scoped user stories with acceptance criteria that engineering can pick up and execute against. Work closely with the design team throughout the product lifecycle, providing direction and feedback on user experience and design solutions to ensure they align with product requirements. When developers raise product or specification questions, drive them to a fast resolution, pulling in customers, internal teams, and leadership as needed, so the team is never stuck waiting on a decision. Develop deep, end-to-end knowledge of each feature: the workflows, the data, and the customer’s reality, so the team builds the right thing the right way. Shepherd work through discovery, design, build, and release within an agile process, keeping the backlog healthy and work moving. Interview and understand customers, present ideas and recommendations clearly to the VP and other internal leaders, and maintain a strong, collaborative working relationship with the development team. Stay close to how legal professionals use Tabs3 and Orion, and let that understanding inform every product decision. WE OFFER US and EU projects based on advanced technologies. Competitive compensation based on skills and experience. Comprehensive private medical insurance. Regular performance appraisals to support your growth. Flexibility in workspace, either remote, our welcoming office or local coworking. Bonuses for recommendations of new employees. Bonuses for article writing, public talks, other activities. 15 vacation days, 10 national holidays, 10 sick leaves. Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development. Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla. Fun corporate online\offline celebrations and activities. Well-established remote culture. Awesome team, friendly and supportive community!

complete product life cycles, including evaluating technologies, supporting estimation and budgeting for pre-sales and technical proposals, and contributing to planning and We are waiting for you!</p><p></p>

title: Technical Service Delivery Manager
description: About Motivus At Motivus, we believe in unlocking human potential through innovative, cutting-edge solutions. With over 1,600 team members across 5 countries, we provide a full spectrum of software and digital services. Our teams are dedicated to driving sustainability, pushing the boundaries of technology, and building the next generation of world-class digital solutions that empower our clients and make a lasting impact. As part of our team, you'll work alongside forward-thinking professionals committed to creating groundbreaking solutions that shape the future of the industry Position Overview We are looking for a highly skilled and technically credible Senior Service Delivery Manager to join our Global Delivery Organization. This is not a traditional management role — we need someone who earns the respect of SDA and SysAdmin agents by truly understanding their domain, not just overseeing it. In this role, you will lead a team of junior technical agents, own SLA/KPI performance with real contractual accountability, and serve as the primary client contact for all service delivery and technical escalation matters. You will operate at the intersection of ITIL-based service management, DevOps/CI/CD environments, and people development — driving both operational excellence and team growth. General Information L evel: Senior level — 6+ years of combined experience in IT Service Management and technical supportroles . Modality: Remote. Availability for on-call rotations and off-hours support during critical incidents or deployments . Availab i lity: Full time Language: English (advanced) + Spanish (advanced). Academic Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Equivalent experience accepted when combined with demonstrable technical depth and career progression. Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation certified (required). ITIL 4 Managing Professional strongly preferred. Key Responsibilties Team Leadership & Technical Coaching Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of Junior Application Support Agents (SDA and SysAdmin profiles) in day-to-day service delivery. Act as the technical reference point for the team: validate escalation decisions, guide triage logic, and close knowledge gaps in real time. Run daily standups, ticket queue reviews, and structured 1:1s; design individual development plans aligned to each agent's technical track. Set clear expectations, deliver real-time feedback, and be present — visibly and actively — during critical shifts and major incidents. Incident & Problem Management Own the end-to-end Incident Management lifecycle: lead P1/P2 bridges, coordinate resolution, and drive stakeholder communication. Validate and challenge agent-level diagnostics; ensure root cause analysis goes deep enough before incidents are closed. Drive a proactive Problem Management culture: identify recurring technical failure patterns, manage the KEDB, and lead structured remediation. Define and maintain incident response playbooks, escalation trees, and triage checklists for DevOps, Build, and SysAdmin support domains. SDLC & Technical Operations Oversight Liaise with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure support agents have the context needed to triage effectively in CI/CD and build environments. Identify gaps between agent technical capability and the team's support scope; drive training, documentation, and knowledge transferinitiatives. Champion automation and tooling improvements that reduce manual effort and ticket volume across the team. SLA Performance & Continuous Improvment Own SLA/KPI accountability for the account; monitor in-period performance and take corrective action before breaches occur. Design and execute Get-to-Green (GtG) plans when service performance falls below contractual targets. Benchmark team performance quarter-over-quarter; present improvement trends to clients and leadership with data and narrative. Client Relationship & Reporting Serve as the primary point of contact for the client on all service delivery and technical escalation matters. Lead service review meetings and QBRs; deliver SLA/KPI reports that translate technical outcomes into business language. Proactively communicate risks, trends, and improvements — before the client has to ask. Identify opportunities for account improvement and communicate them to internal leadership. Required Experience 6+ years in IT roles combining service delivery, technical support, or software/systems operations. 3+ years in a Service Delivery Manager, Technical Lead, or equivalent people-management role with direct reports. Hands-on background in at least one of the technical domains managed by the team: DevOps/CI/CD pipelines, Linux SysAdmin, C/C++ build systems, or application debugging. Demonstrated experience leading and coaching junior technical agents (SDA/SysAdmin profile) in a managed services or software support environment. Proven accountability for SLA/KPI performance in production environments with real contractual obligations. Experience operating within SDLC-adjacent support functions: release cycles, build pipelines, and environment management. MSP, outsourcing, or multi-client delivery experience is a strong advantage. Technical Knowledge Required ITIL v4 Framework: deep working knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management — applied daily, not just theoretical. Incident Management: leads P1/P2 bridges autonomously; enforces correct classification, escalation, and documentation; tracks incident trends. Problem Management: conducts formal RCA sessions; manages the KEDB; drives measurable reduction of recurring technical incidents. SLA Management: in-period monitoring to anticipate and prevent breaches; accountable for contractual outcomes; designs and executes GtG plans. ITSM Tooling: advanced proficiency in ServiceNow, JIRA Service Management, or equivalent; configures queues, SLA rules, dashboards, and audit-ready reports. SDLC Awareness: understands the Software Development Lifecycle from requirements through deployment and production support. Linux & OS Fundamentals: comfortable navigating Linux environments; understands OS-level concepts relevant to SDA and SysAdmin agents. CI/CD & DevOps Concepts: knowledgeable in CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git/SCM), and deployment processes; can interpret pipeline failures. Build Systems: familiar with C/C++ build concepts, Make, gcc/clang, and common build errors; able to coach agents and validate escalation decisions. Scripting Literacy: reads and interprets scripts in Python, Bash, Perl, or JavaScript; can validate agent-proposed fixes without writing production code independently. Debugging & Monitoring: understands debugging tools (gdb, pdb, IDE-based debuggers) and monitoring platforms; reviews agent diagnostics. Service Reporting: designs and delivers weekly/monthly/quarterly SLA/KPI reports; translates technical data into clear operational narratives. Nice to Have Familiarity with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and their integration into developer support workflows. Knowledge of ASAN/Valgrind, GCOV, or similar profiling and code quality tools. Cloud platform fundamentals (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at an operational support level. Why Join Us? Grow Your Career: At Motivus, you will have the opportunity to expand your skills and take on leadership roles in diverse projects. Work on Emerging Tech: Be at the forefront of innovation by working with cutting-edge tech nologies and methodologies. Collaborative Environment: Work with talented teams that value your ideas and contributions . Learning and Development: We offer a range of L&D programs to help you advance your career. Client-Centric Approach: Contribute to solutions that create lasting value for global Fortune 500 clients. Our Values Culture of Innovation: We pursue innovation relentlessly, encouraging our teams to explore new ideas and technologies. Responsibility: We give back to the communities that support us and our clients . Learning & Development: Our employees lead, learn, and grow, supporting themselves and our clients.

title: Product Manager
description: <p><strong>About AppDirect</strong></p><p>Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world.  AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service.  We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations.  We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.</p><p><strong>About you</strong></p><p>The core mission of the product management team at AppDirect is to improve how cloud software and solutions are discovered, purchased and managed globally. We have a strong passion for creating best-in-class user experiences at every stage of the customer journey. We thrive on turning complex technical challenges into elegant customer-focused solutions that are scalable and easy to use. Catering to a diverse ecosystem of cloud commerce vendors, channels and users requires us to creatively think our way through challenges, with a dual focus on product quality and time-to-market. We learn, holding each other accountable, while also being committed to our shared success.</p><p>You are an experienced product manager to lead the evolution of our reseller and CPQ services, with a particular focus on creating one of the industry’s best advisor selling experiences. You will own strategy and execution for features that enable advisors to prospect, solution, price, upsell, and manage quotes quickly and intuitively.</p><p>The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more.</p><p><strong>What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact</strong></p><ul><li>Own and evolve the advisor selling journey: design and deliver a world-class self-serve quoting experience that enables advisors to create accurate quotes quickly, customize offers, and close deals with minimal friction.</li><li>Nail and scale adoption: define, document and roll out playbooks, product patterns and operational processes so advisor selling workflows scale across geographies, partners, and channels.</li><li>Leverage AI and automation: design and ship AI-enabled capabilities (recommendations, pre-fill, bundle suggestions, predictive pricing, automated validations, and intelligent workflows) to make quote creation and ongoing quote management more intuitive and operationally efficient.</li><li>Partner broadly to drive adoption: work closely with business partners, channel sales, sales operations and advisor communities to deeply understand needs, pilot new capabilities, and drive adoption through enablement and change management.</li><li>Build data-driven feedback loops: establish both quantitative (usage metrics, funnel conversion, business KPIs, A/B tests) and qualitative (advisor interviews, support tickets) feedback channels to prioritize improvements and iterate quickly on the quoting experience.</li><li>Create a universal quoting experience: collaborate with AppDirect’s first party services and other internal stakeholders to deliver a compelling, cross-sell enabling quoting platform that surfaces relevant products across lines of business and unlocks new revenue opportunities.</li><li>Define success and measure impact: own KPIs for advisor adoption, quote velocity, conversion, average deal size, time-to-quote, and operational cost reductions; convert insights into prioritized roadmaps and experiments.</li><li>Communicate and evangelize: produce sales enablement materials, product documentation, and training content; represent the product internally and externally, and serve as the voice of the customer across the company.</li><li>Execute with engineering and design: write clear business requirements, partner with UX and engineering to build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery.</li></ul><p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p><ul><li>3+ years of product management experience in reseller/partner management, CPQ, quoting platforms, or related SaaS commerce products.</li><li>Demonstrated experience owning or shipping advisor/reseller selling experiences or CPQ workflows at scale and measurable success driving adoption.</li><li>Strong track record of partnering with sales, sales ops, channel teams, and external advisors to pilot features and drive adoption.</li><li>Experience designing and operating quantitative and qualitative feedback loops (instrumentation, analytics, experiments, advisor interviews, voice-of-customer programs).</li><li>Deep understanding of multi-tenant SaaS at scale, with a focus on usability, performance, reliability and security.</li><li>Excellent communication skills with comfort presenting to executives and cross-functional stakeholders; ability to translate customer needs into pragmatic product roadmaps.</li><li>Strong analytical skills, comfortable defining KPIs, interpreting product metrics and using data to prioritize and validate hypotheses.</li><li>Experience working with Agile teams and modern product development practices, including working with AI in your workflows.</li><li>Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.</li><li>Bonus: experience with integrations across CRM/ERP/first-party services, or prior exposure to sales enablement platforms and quoting integrations.</li></ul><p><em>At AppDirect, we believe that innovation thrives in an environment that houses diversity of excellence, experience and thought. We respect each AppDirector as their own fingerprint; unique with no one alike. We foster an environment of inclusion without regard to race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity enabling AppDirectors to embrace their uniqueness to do their best work. As such, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities.</em></p><p><em>At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our</em><em> </em><em>use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice:</em><em> </em></p><p><em>https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice</em></p><p></p>

Our mission has remained constant from day one: to unlock access and enable companies and consumers to participate in the digital economy, no matter where they are.<br><br>What started as a bold vision has grown into a platform that connects some of the world's largest digital businesses with customers across 21 of the fastest-growing markets. We operate where complexity exists — turning local challenges into global opportunities, and building the infrastructure that allows payments to move further, faster, and smarter.<br><br>We are a team of builders and problem-solvers. We think globally, act with curiosity, and believe diversity of thought is a competitive advantage.<br><br>As EBANX enters its next phase of hyper growth, we are looking for people who want to shape the future of payments, expand what's possible, and help connect businesses and consumers across borders.<br><br>Let's build what's next — together.<br><br>At EBANX's Product team you don't just create features. You develop user-centered solutions that transform the experience of millions of consumers and global companies. Every product decision you make has a real impact on the future of digital payments, combining strategic vision, innovation, and collaboration to make our work truly <strong>Out Of The Ordinary</strong>.<br><br>As a<strong> Group Product Manager </strong>you will lead the strategy, vision, and execution of EBANX's payment solutions. This is a leadership role that sits at the intersection of product strategy, commercial growth, and team development. You will own the product direction for South Cone LatAm payments end-to-end, while simultaneously building and nurturing a high-performing team of product managers.<br><br>You will be accountable for translating EBANX's strategic ambitions into a clear, executable product roadmap — driving adoption, expanding market share, and ensuring our payment solutions remain best-in-class for global merchants. This role demands a leader who can operate at altitude when setting vision, and get into the details when it matters.<br><br><strong>What your day-to-day will look like<br><br></strong><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Vision<br><br></strong><ul><li>Define and own the multi-year product strategy for our payment solutions, aligned with EBANX's global ambitions and local market dynamics;</li><li>Translate business objectives into a compelling, prioritized roadmap that balances short-term commercial wins with long-term platform investments;</li><li>Act as the executive voice of the South Cone LatAm payments product across the organization — from C-level alignment to cross-functional execution;</li><li>Identify emerging market trends, regulatory shifts, and competitive movements to proactively shape product direction;<br><br></li></ul><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Development<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and customer obsession;</li><li>Set clear expectations, provide ongoing coaching, and drive career development for each team member;</li><li>Establish effective product practices across the team — discovery, delivery, go-to-market, and performance monitoring;</li><li>Create clarity on roles, responsibilities, and decision-making frameworks to enable the team to operate with autonomy;<br><br></li></ul><strong>Commercial Impact &amp; description: Who We Are We are a leading BIM company specializing in hands-on, field-focused Building Information Modeling (BIM) services. Since our establishment in 2007, we’ve grown into the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, with over 5,000 projects completed. Our dedicated team of more than 500 professionals delivers tailored BIM solutions, including MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM, by collaborating with architects, engineers, and owners to meet their specific needs. The Role As a Senior BIM Product Owne r, you will serve as the key intermediary between the production and development teams. You will be responsible for analyzing production requests and translating them into well-defined product requirements. This includes shaping user experiences, delivering detailed technical specifications, and ensuring that business objectives align with product vision and strategy Top Job Responsibilities Gathering and Documenting Requirement s: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze business requirements. Process Improvemen t: Identify and recommend improvements to business processes and workflows. Communication and Collaboratio n: Liaise between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables. Product Vision and Strateg y: Define, develop, and communicate the product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals. Roadmap and Prioritizatio n: Create and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on customer needs and business goals. Stakeholder Managemen t: Work with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing, and sales) to ensure successful product development and launch. Minimum Requirements and skills 5+ BIM Product Owner experience 5+ years of experience in product lifecycle management, with experience in agile methodologies. Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar certification. Advanced proficiency in English Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis tools (Excel, SQL). Knowledge of BIM or AEC. Familiarity with tools like Jira, SQL, Excel, and Revit is a plus . You are great for this role if you: Are adaptable and able to adjust to different industries, with experience in a variety of projects and products. Have experience working with data and applying it to business or product decisions. Company Culture and Values 🤝 Candor: We value honesty, openness, and sincerity in all interactions. 🎯 Accountability: We take ownership and are committed to delivering high-quality work on time. 🌟 Win-Win Mentality: We strive for mutual success in all business relationships. Why join us? Explore our amazing benefits! ✨ 🌍 Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space. 🌴No Policy for PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it. 🎉 Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, fun challenges and team celebrations. 🎓Continuous Learning: Programs to develop your technical and soft skills. 💻Work Equipment to Keep You Productive: We provide everything you need to create the perfect workspace. 🎧Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. title: Senior Product Manager - Argentina
description: Nuestro equipo de Producto Nuestro equipo de Producto es responsable de desarrollar, crear y lanzar nuevas funcionalidades que impulsan el ecosistema de Tiendanube, en colaboración con los equipos de Diseño e Ingeniería. En el equipo de Catalog tu misión será gestionar el núcleo de nuestra plataforma, asegurando que la estructura de datos y los servicios de catálogo sean escalables, robustos y estén preparados para respaldar el crecimiento de miles de comerciantes en Latinoamérica. description: <strong>🌟 <strong>We’re Hiring!! Product Manager - SaaS Startup<br><br></strong></strong><strong>Location:</strong> Remote (Brazil-based preferred)<br><br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Chief Technology Officer<br><br><strong>About Our Client<br><br></strong>Our client is transforming how companies build and manage partnerships. Today, partnerships drive 30–50% of company revenue, yet most partner teams still rely on spreadsheets, email threads, and outdated CRMs—tools that were never built for partnerships at scale. The result? Wasted time, lost opportunities, and inefficiencies that limit growth.<br><br>Despite their strategic importance, partnerships remain the only go-to-market function without dedicated, modern software. With only a quarter of teams using purpose-built partner management tools, a multi-billion-dollar market is wide open for disruption.<br><br>Our client is addressing this gap with a next-generation platform that helps partner teams scale smarter. Their intuitive, automated solution replaces manual work with streamlined workflows, from partner onboarding and engagement to real-time deal tracking.<br><br>The company is <strong>bootstrapped, profitable, and growing rapidly</strong>—doubling revenue quarter over quarter. In less than a year, it has become one of the fastest-growing platforms in the space, consistently outperforming legacy solutions. The team moves fast, builds intentionally, and focuses on delivering real customer value.<br><br>If you’re excited to solve complex problems, collaborate with talented teammates, and help define the future of partner technology, this is your opportunity.<br><br>The Role<br><br>Our client is hiring their <strong>first Product Manager outside of the founding team</strong>. You’ll report directly to the CTO and collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, and customer success. This is not just about managing releases—it’s about shaping the company’s product direction and customer experience.<br><br>You’ll own the entire product lifecycle: understanding customer pain points, defining strategy, managing execution, and driving adoption of new features.<br><br>What You’ll Do<br><br><ul><li>Define Product Strategy: Work with leadership to build and prioritize the roadmap, balancing immediate impact with long-term vision. </li><li>Lead Discovery &amp; Research: Engage with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to uncover needs and opportunities. </li><li>Translate Insights into Action: Create clear product specs, define requirements, and collaborate closely with engineering and design. </li><li>Drive Execution: Plan and manage sprints, track progress, and ensure timely, high-quality product releases. </li><li>Champion the User Experience: Ensure the product is not only powerful but also intuitive and delightful to use. </li><li>Measure &amp; Iterate: Define success metrics, monitor adoption, and continuously improve product performance. <br><br></li></ul>What We’re Looking For<br><br><ul><li>Strategic thinker: You can connect day-to-day decisions to the broader company vision. </li><li>Operational excellence: You know how to break down complex problems into actionable steps and deliver results. </li><li>Customer obsession: You thrive on understanding user needs and turning them into impactful solutions. </li><li>Technical fluency: You can discuss trade-offs with engineers and write clear, actionable requirements. </li><li>Execution-driven mindset: You’re comfortable managing sprints and ensuring accountability. </li><li>Tool proficiency: Experience with ClickUp or similar tools for sprint and task management is strongly preferred. </li><li>Experience: 4–6+ years in Product Management for B2B SaaS products—ideally with integrations, workflows, or enterprise software. <br><br></li></ul>Why Join<br><br><ul><li>Be the first product hire at a profitable, high-growth SaaS company. </li><li>Work directly with the founders to shape both the product and the company’s direction. </li><li>Build features that impact every stage of the partner lifecycle—from referrals to payments. </li><li>Join a small, agile team that values speed, ownership, and creativity. <br><br></li></ul>Thanks!

title: LatAm - Senior Product Owner
description: Job Description The Senior Product Owner role will focus on leading client interactions with Product Managers and business stakeholders, understanding both client business requirements as well as end-user functional requirements, and may manage multiple product owners that have delivery targeted towards a single product or solution. In situations where a Senior Product Owner is supporting multiple delivery streams, that person has sole responsibility and ownership of the product in its entirety. Responsibilities Duties and Responsibilites Act as the primary liaison between the client and the delivery team, ensuring alignment with the client-defined product roadmap. Translate client requirements into clear, actionable user stories and tasks for the development team. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog to ensure timely and high-quality delivery. Conduct regular follow-ups with key stakeholders to gather missing information, clarify requirements, and ensure alignment with expectations. Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Ensure that the team has a clear and up-to-date plan to follow at all times. Monitor progress against delivery milestones and proactively manage risks and dependencies. Provide regular updates to internal and external stakeholders on delivery status and team performance. Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement. Technical Skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong organizational and prioritization abilities. Proactive and detail-oriented, with a focus on execution. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure. Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. Healthcare industry knowledge desired. Qualifications These are the minimum qualifications required for someone to be considered for this position. Qualifications include: Education – Bachelor’s Degree 5 to 7 years of working experience in like field Strong communication skills Detailed oriented 2 to 5 years of supervisory experience Experience in agile and scrum development organizations Certification - Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) required About Us Perficient is the global AI and technology consulting firm disrupting the traditional consulting model. Powered by our 7,000+ advisors, engineers, and designers, Perficient implements AI-first solutions that break conventions and deliver outcomes that matter. Proudly serving clients that represent the world’s most innovative brands, and in collaboration with our powerful technology partner ecosystem, we bring deep industry expertise and data-driven design to redefine how businesses run and succeed. Perficient is different. For real. Learn more at perficient.com . Select work authorization questions to ask when applicants apply 1. Are you legally authorized to work in the United States? 2. Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H-1B visa status)?

dependencies to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li><li>Ability to work with senior stakeholders while still staying close to daily delivery details.</li><li>Strong ownership mindset, structured thinking, and practical problem-solving skills.</li><li>Ability to build process discipline without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Skills and Business Familiartity:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience with software platforms used in supply chain, distribution, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or electronic components industries.</li><li>Experience supporting internal business platforms used by sales, purchasing, warehouse, finance, operations, or customer service teams.</li><li>Experience with .NET / SQL Server-based enterprise systems or similar business-critical platforms.</li><li>Familiarity with mobile applications, warehouse workflows, computer vision, NLP, AI / ML use cases, or data-driven internal tools.</li><li>Experience coordinating delivery across globally distributed teams.</li><li>Experience working with business analysts, technical product owners, architects, QA leads, DevOps engineers, DBAs, and infrastructure teams.</li><li>Understanding of production support, defect triage, release readiness, and incident follow-up processes.</li><li>Experience improving backlog description: <p><strong>About the Company</strong></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p>We are a premier, ultra-luxury hospitality and maritime brand that has redefined the high-end travel space by bringing five-star resort standards to the world’s oceans. Operating an exclusive, custom-built fleet of luxury superyachts, we deliver bespoke, highly personalized travel experiences across global destinations. Behind our seamless guest experience lies an intricate, shoreside operational engine driven by global data, complex maritime logistics, and digital innovation. We are rapidly expanding our data and enterprise capabilities to better predict customer desires and build a truly data-driven hospitality ecosystem.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p>We are seeking a Business Architect with mid-level experience to help define and connect business capabilities, processes, and data needs to enterprise strategic goals. roadmap.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><ul><li>Support the development and maintenance of business architecture frameworks that align strategic requirements.</li><li>Help ensure data products, reporting models, and analytics solutions reflect real business processes and operational requirements.</li><li>Communicate complex business and data initiatives.</li></ul><p><br></p><p> </p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Finance, Operations, or a related field.</li><li>4–6 years of experience in business architecture, business analysis, process improvement, or enterprise transformation roles.</li><li>Experience with business architecture, title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1. We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey. This is not a coordination role. You will own the layer of ASAPP’s platform that connects GenerativeAgent to the real world — integrations, SDKs, agent interoperability, voice channels, and the developer experience that underpins all of it. These are load-bearing systems: if they do not work, customers cannot deploy our solution and deals do not close. You will set and execute the strategy for a product surface that spans API Connections (our integration hub), the developer SDKs, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interoperability, MCP servers, workflows, and telephony integrations. You will work directly with engineering leads across these areas and will be the PM voice in conversations with customers, account teams, and executive stakeholders. The scope will evolve as our AI architecture evolves, so the strongest candidates will be comfortable shaping a moving target — and will bring the technical depth to anticipate what the right target is. What You Will Do You will own a set of interconnected product areas and be accountable for their strategy, roadmap, and outcomes. Below is what that looks like concretely. Own the API Connections platform and manage the backlog of platform bets. Manage the commercial relationship with our third-party providers. Define and execute the A2A and MCP server roadmap. Customers are agentifying their internal workflows and want our agentic solutions to orchestrate against them. Decide how and when to expose these externally, and shape broader strategies so multiple teams build coherently rather than in isolation. Lead the developer SDKs. The SDK is the surface through which end users experience ASAPP. Own the roadmap and ensure investments stay aligned with the underlying platform. Manage telephony and platform integrations — the connective tissue between our solution and customers’ CCaaS stacks. Triage inbound requests with a bias toward saying no cleanly and early; the approach for each integration pattern is defined and the goal is disciplined execution, not proliferation. Own external documentation (docs.asapp.com) as part of the product. Define the structure, processes, and standards — working with the team to execute. Drive a docs-first approach where documentation ships with features, not after them. Across All Of These Areas Set strategy and own the roadmap — balancing active customer commitments, tech debt, and platform bets. Work directly with customers and account teams to prioritize and sequence delivery Maintain ruthless prioritization: actively manage and prune the backlog; say no with clarity and evidence. Establish metrics and telemetry for each product area so outcomes are measurable and decisions are data-driven. Who You Are We evaluate candidates against a set of principles. These are not interview talking points — they describe how PMs are expected to operate here every day. Growth & Abundance Mindset: You approach new domains with curiosity and learn fast. You see collaboration as additive, not competitive. When a bet does not work, you extract the signal and move on. Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You do not wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the PM; the outcome is yours. High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer “what changed for the customer?” for everything on your roadmap. Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned. You know when to drive consensus and when to make a call. Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously. You do not save it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively. What You Will Need 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise B2B SaaS and native AI platforms. Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on API design, SDK architecture, integration patterns, and AI/ML tradeoffs — you are hands-on producing working prototypes and you need to understand production code. Demonstrated ability to own a complex, multi-surface product area with minimal oversight. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and delivery teams to translate pain into prioritized roadmap. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving to clarity — you can structure an undefined problem before engineering has to. Track record of shipping: you have owned features from discovery through delivery, including the parts that are not exciting. What We Would Like To See Expert with integration platform or developer experience products (API gateways, SDKs, MCP/A2A protocols, webhooks, OAuth flows) Experience with voice or telephony products, CCaaS platforms Proven background in enterprise onboarding Comfort navigating AI/ML systems — not just as a user but as someone who can reason about model behavior, latency tradeoffs, and accuracy/trust requirements Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment where the role definition evolved as the company did Experience owning or meaningfully improving developer-facing documentation — API references, integration guides, and SDK docs. Benefits Competitive compensation Stock options Healthcare for the family group Mac equipment USD 150 per month in flexible benefits 3 weeks of vacation English lessons ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Owner
description: JOB DUCK IS HIRING A PRODUCT OWNER For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive. As a lifestyle company we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification for 4 years! Role Overview The Talent Community Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the value delivered by the Talent Community product and lifecycle (portal experience + candidate/Staffer journeys), enhancing the overall experience within the Job Duck Talent Community, from Candidates preparing for placement to Staffers advancing in their careers. This role owns the Talent Community product vision and roadmap, prioritizing the backlog to maximize member quality, readiness, and placement outcomes. Working through the Talent Community Committee and delivery partners, it aligns cross-functional efforts, establishes clear product goals, manages tradeoffs, and drives continuous improvement, using data to support broader organizational goals. Schedule: Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM EST (USA) Your Responsibilities Will Include but Are Not Limited To: Translating Talent Community strategy into clear product goals, success measures, and backlog priorities. Owning and maintaining a transparent backlog and roadmap, prioritizing by value, effort, risk, and dependencies, and pushing back on misaligned requests to protect focus and capacity. Running the Talent Community Committee cadence for intake, prioritization, decisioning, escalation, and dependency management, keeping stakeholders aligned on priorities, constraints, and rationale. Defining and communicating the Talent Community product goal(s) and success measures, aligned to business priorities. Publishing outcome readouts tied to KPIs and experiments (what changed, what moved, what's next) and using the insights to re-prioritize. Defining "ready" work by turning needs into clear backlog items with user stories and acceptance criteria for features, enhancements, and workflows. Partnering with cross-functional owners to clarify scope, manage tradeoffs, and ship high-quality iterations that deliver measurable value. Representing the candidate/Staffer voice in prioritization and decision-making across the product lifecycle. Leading continuous improvement by using candidate/Staffer feedback and performance data to identify friction, run pilots/A/B tests when appropriate, scale what works, and stop what doesn't. What We’re Looking For: At least three years of experience in a Product Owner (or equivalent) role with backlog ownership and demonstrated prioritization authority. Experience defining success metrics (KPIs) and using performance insights to reprioritize roadmaps/backlogs. Familiarity with experimentation and measurement (A/B testing, segmentation/cohorts, funnel analysis). Experience leading cross-functional governance (cadences, decisioning, escalation, dependency alignment) and managing stakeholder tradeoffs. Experience partnering with technical delivery teams in iterative environments (preferred). Experience in staffing, talent acquisition, onboarding, lifecycle programs, or talent development (preferred). Technical skills (Required) : BI and dashboard literacy, Experimentation and measurement, Data interpretation and insight communication, Requirements documentation, Data quality and governance basics Technical skills (Preferred): Data querying literacy, Automation/analysis tooling familiarity, Version control familiarity, Data pipeline and integration awareness, Transformation framework awareness Behavioral Skills (Required): Business acumen, Stakeholder management, Coaching and feedback Reliable computer setup (laptop/PC, headset, stable internet min. 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload) Quiet, distraction-free remote work environment What’s In It for You? Paid time off . 100% Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term Career Opportunity. Parental leave. Opportunities for professional development and training Dedicated support from our team. A chance to work with clients who share our values. Ready to dive in? Apply now and make sure to follow all the instructions! DISCLAIMER: Every candidate must pass each step in our application process to become part of our team. Ensure you have all the required documentation ready to streamline your application process.

Here at Rootstrap, we deliver exceptional work and have a great time doing it and this seat is for someone who gets genuine satisfaction from a team that ships consistently, sprint after sprint. This is a hands-on, embedded role, not a roaming strategy seat. You’ll be 100% allocated to one client pod, sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with designers and engineers, turning a vision into a backlog and a backlog into shipped product. You’ll be the steady hand the team relies on: the person who keeps the work clear, prioritized, and moving. We’re after someone who wants depth over breadth to know one product and one team deeply, build real trust, and become the operational backbone of the pod. What are the main responsibilities of this role? Own the backlog end to end: refine, prioritize, and sequence work so the team always knows what’s next and why. Translate requirements into precise, developer-ready user stories and acceptance criteria the team can pick up and run with. Drive the delivery process across multiple initiatives in parallel, keeping scope, dependencies, and expectations under control. Run the day-to-day agile cadence: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives, and demos. Manage stakeholders and their expectations with clear, frequent, honest communication. Partner with engineering and design to remove blockers and keep the pod shipping at a steady, sustainable pace. Use AI to multiply the team’s output: apply modern AI tooling to accelerate spec writing, backlog grooming, requirement analysis, QA support, and reporting and automate the repetitive work so the team can focus on what matters. Contribute to product discovery and roadmap conversations as a trusted voice while the core of the role stays firmly in execution and delivery. Which skills and experience do we envision for this role? Minimum of 3+ years owning delivery as a Product Owner / Product Manager / Business Analyst in software teams, with a proven track record of shipping. Strong backlog ownership: writing crisp user stories, prioritizing ruthlessly, and keeping a delivery team unblocked. Hands-on experience using AI tools to do the job better — e.g. drafting specs/stories, summarizing requirements, automating routine workflows, accelerating analysis and reporting. You should be genuinely fluent in working with AI, not just curious about it. Advanced or bilingual English for non-native speakers. A technical background (computer science, engineering, systems, informatics, or similar) is strongly preferred it signals the kind of disposition toward delivery and the development process this role rewards. Advanced experience with Agile, plus comfort operating in mixed or waterfall-leaning environments when the engagement calls for it. Demonstrable craft in prioritization, requirement analysis, facilitation, negotiation, ownership, and technical writing. Relevant technical skills data analysis, product analytics, A/B testing, and programming basics are a plus. Located in Argentina, Uruguay or Colombia; we primarily work with clients in the EST and PST time zones, accommodating their schedules as needed. What expect of this role? You’d rather ship something real every sprint than spend your week in strategy decks. You like the rhythm and trust that come from going deep with one team and product. You see AI as a force multiplier and you’re already using it to automate the boring parts. You measure success by what the pod delivers, not by the size of your mandate. Join our team and enjoy: Access to Rootstrap University,Conferences/Certifications, and a Mentorship Program for your professional growth. Learning Bonus. Opportunities to organize cross-functional initiatives and receive 360 Feedback to improve your skills continuously. The flexibility to work remotely or from our offices in Montevideo, Buenos Aires, and Medellín, with a flexible time schedule and Workation program. Gym benefits, psychological counseling, and weekly lunch reimbursements with special foods in the offices. An Onboarding kit and access to cutting-edge technologies and tools to make your work easier. After offices, Prizes, and special occasions gifts to celebrate your achievements. People Care referent to support your well-being and personal development. We value your well-being and happiness. We grow together! How we work: We offer a flexible and diverse work environment that fosters multicultural talent We value autonomy and creativity, We want people to bring ideas to the table and to think as leaders. We put our focus on real human connections We have a commitment to excellence At Rootstrap, we help companies launch, grow, and scale their digital products and services. With over 160 global team members, we’ve built products for clients like MasterClass, Universal, Google, as well as innovative startups and inspired pioneers. Earning regular recognition with Fastest Growing Company & Best B2B Service Provider Industry accolades, our team prides itself on making an impact that transcends our efforts. We have offices in Uruguay, Argentina, and Colombia, providing the flexibility to work remotely. Know more about life at Rootstrap visiting https://www.rootstrap.com/careers All of our candidate searches are covered under Uruguayan Law 19691 (the purpose of this law is to promote the inclusion of people with disabilities). title: Senior Product Manager - Remote
description: We are seeking a Senior Product Manager for a Short-Term Contract to lead the integration and expansion of a rapidly growing digital health platform that unifies clinical and wellness services into a single user experience. This role will focus on defining how new offerings—including diagnostics, genetics, prescribing, and emerging therapeutic products—are integrated into the platform in a cohesive, scalable way. The ideal candidate brings deep experience at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and product management, with strong knowledge of healthcare workflows, regulatory considerations, and AI-native product development. This is a highly collaborative, remote consulting engagement requiring significant overlap with US Eastern Time and close partnership with engineering, clinical, compliance, and executive stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Define and lead product integration strategy across the platform, ensuring new offerings fit seamlessly into existing workflows, data models, and user experiences. Partner with leadership and clinical teams to transform emerging product concepts into clearly defined, scoped, and deliverable solutions. Identify opportunities to standardize workflows, UX patterns, and platform capabilities while maintaining necessary product-specific requirements. Develop and prioritize product roadmaps across multiple initiatives, balancing business objectives, user needs, and technical constraints. Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture, integrations, and platform scalability considerations. Translate complex clinical, operational, and regulatory requirements into intuitive, compliant product experiences. Leverage modern AI tools and methodologies to accelerate product development and identify meaningful AI-driven opportunities for patients and providers. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, gather user insights, and drive continuous iteration and improvement. Facilitate alignment across distributed, cross-functional teams operating across multiple time zones. Core Requirements 6+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products and owning significant product areas. Strong experience within healthcare , wellness, clinical services, diagnostics, longevity, functional health, or related healthcare technology sectors. Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including engineering, clinical, operations, and compliance teams. Experience designing and managing platform-based products that integrate multiple services, workflows, or third-party systems. Working knowledge of HIPAA , healthcare data privacy, PHI handling, consent management, and regulatory considerations. Strong understanding of product architecture, integrations, data models, and workflow design. Experience utilizing modern AI tools and AI-enabled product development practices. Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and bring structure, clarity, and alignment to evolving product initiatives. Excellent prioritization, roadmap planning, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English . Ability to work independently in a remote , fast-paced environment. Nice-to-Have Experience with diagnostics, genetics, laboratory ordering and results workflows, prescription management, or telehealth products. Familiarity with direct-to-consumer healthcare models, provider-network platforms, or digital health operations. Experience integrating third-party clinical, wellness, or healthcare services into a unified product ecosystem. Familiarity with: Healthie (EHR / HIPAA-compliant care platform) Keragon (HIPAA-compliant workflow automation) Health Gorilla (lab data integration) Go High Level (CRM and marketing automation) Fullscript (supplement dispensing) Thinkific (learning management platform) Additional US Timezone Overlap: Full daily overlap with US Eastern Time (EST/EDT) required. The icing on the Kake: 💵 Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally. 🏡 Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you. 🌱 Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions. ❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good. Please Note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
