title: Product Owner
description: About us: Babio is building the first AI employee for home and small commercial service companies. Our platform automates the entire marketing and sales journey—from lead generation and qualification to quoting, follow-up, appointment booking, and contract signing. Using AI agents, companies can instantly qualify leads, generate accurate quotes, and fill their sales pipeline automatically, directly from their website. Think of it as adding a 24/7 marketing and sales team that never misses a lead, scales instantly, and operates at a fraction of the cost of traditional vendors or in-house teams. We're on a mission to transform how home service businesses acquire customers and grow, replacing manual processes with intelligent AI systems that work around the clock. Responsibilities: We're looking for a Technical Product Owner to help turn business requirements into successful product releases. You will work closely with business managers, engineers, and leadership to define requirements, organize development work, answer implementation questions, test new features, identify issues, and ensure releases meet both business and customer needs. The ideal candidate combines strong business judgment, technical understanding, organization, and attention to detail. They can communicate effectively with engineers, investigate problems, and take ownership of getting features from idea to production. Own features from concept to production, ensuring successful delivery and adoption. Translate business requirements into clear specifications and actionable engineering tasks. Coordinate and prioritize development work across teams. Review, test, and validate new features before release. Identify, document, and investigate bugs, regressions, and functional issues. Use AI tools to improve product design, documentation, testing, and development workflows. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Business Analysis, QA, or a similar role. Strong business judgment and ability to translate requirements into product features. Experience working closely with software engineering teams. Strong organizational and project management skills. Ability to understand technical systems and investigate issues independently. Experience testing web applications and APIs. Excellent written communication and documentation skills. Experience with Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or similar tools. Experience using AI tools in product development workflows. Nice to have: Familiarity with APIs, Postman, JSON, and Chrome DevTools. Nice to have: Basic SQL or database knowledge. What success looks like: Features are delivered faster and with fewer bugs. Engineering receives clear, actionable requirements. Releases happen smoothly and predictably. Product quality improves over time. Customers experience fewer issues. Business goals are translated into product outcomes efficiently.

We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.<br><br><strong>About The Job<br><br></strong>The Cloud Services Delivery team is looking for a Cloud Services Delivery Manager to provide expertise in cloud industry best practices and stay up to date with both current and emerging SAS services. Our team collaborate directly with external customers to ensure SAS solutions align with and adapt to their evolving business needs. We work closely with Product Management, R&amp;D, Technical Support, and Professional Services, and play a key role in shaping the SAS Cloud Customer Experience and driving meaningful business outcomes from customers’ investment in SAS Cloud.<br><br>This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic, customer-facing team at the forefront of cloud innovation at SAS. You'll make a real impact by helping customers unlock the full value of their cloud investment, while deepening your expertise across cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry<br><br><strong>As a Cloud Services Delivery Manager, You Will<br><br></strong><ul><li>Champion and advocate for the customer experience (voice of the customer), provide real-time and on-demand management of assigned enterprise accounts to ensure customers can meet their business goals by leveraging SAS technologies and managed application services. </li><li>Build Customer Success Plans based on customer defined business outcomes, quantifying the customer business benefits and/or outcomes associated with the use of SAS software and managed application services and serve as a ‘connector’ to ensure that cross-functional teams across SAS are engaged and delivering to meet/exceed customer needs. This will result in maintaining strong, long-lasting relationships with our customers built on trust and transparency.</li><li>Partner with the sales organization and Customer Success to win new business, drive customer renewals, growing accounts organically and looking for opportunities to increase SAS usage across customer functions and processes.</li><li>Be accountable for customer Service Level Agreements, including critical situation management which may occur outside of normal business hours and conduct regular managed application service health checkpoints with the customer to ensure that customers are achieving their desired outcomes</li><li>Manage a highly complex and varied portfolio of solutions and managed application services that may have a global footprint and require engagement outside of normal business hours. </li><li>Proactively provide attention and escalation for urgent issues or concerns during the customer lifecycle with SAS, provide expertise in ITIL processes to manage customer service delivery and support and apply critical thinking on service issues to drive issue resolution, ensuring root cause analysis and corrective action are taken with the appropriate teams. </li><li>Oversee customer budgets to ensure profitability, lead performance, monitoring and hosting capacity assessments, and recommend changes to maintain optimal application performance. Provide regular feedback on products, costs, and customer experience to drive continuous improvement, implement data-driven process enhancements, and track all outstanding pre- and post-delivery issues, ensuring timely updates and resolution.</li><li>Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.</li><li>Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Required Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Previous experience in a similar, Customer supporting role. </li><li>ITIL qualified will be preferred although it is not essential. </li><li>Excellent communication skills, ability to work well under pressure and establish and maintain strong customer relationships. </li><li>Fluent in Spanish &amp; English. </li><li>Experience in presenting to end users. </li><li>Ability to work independently and as part of a team. </li><li>Aptitude to learn and understand technical concepts, structures, requirements, environments, etc. </li><li>Ability to influence, collaborate, and direct the work of other functional teams across organizational boundaries </li><li>Bachelor's degree or technical certification(s) preferred but not required. </li><li>An equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.<br><br></li></ul><strong>  Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills<br><br></strong><ul><li>Service Management – Delivering high-quality services that meet customer and business needs.</li><li>Ownership – Taking responsibility and driving tasks to completion.</li><li>Managing Relationships – Building strong, collaborative connections with stakeholders.<br><br></li></ul><strong>You are welcome here.<br><br></strong>At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.<br><br><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><em>SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com.<br><br></em>Let's stay in touch! title: Product Owner: Building Climate Solutions for Cities
description: Product Owner: Building Climate Solutions for Cities Link to application: https://noteforms.com/forms/product-owner-job-application-m6ylpo Have you built a solid career in technology and now want your work to actually matter? Open Earth Foundation is a California-based nonprofit on a mission to create groundbreaking technology that helps combat the climate crisis. Our flagship platform, CityCatalyst, supports cities around the world with data-driven climate planning and delivery. We’re a diverse, global team working remotely and collaborating with partners worldwide to make real change possible. With strong funding and a powerhouse team of innovators, we’re ready to tackle big challenges for a resilient Earth for generations to come and we need the planet’s brightest minds to help solve them! Your mission, should you choose to accept it: As a Product Owner at Open Earth Foundation, help drive the development of open-source climate data platforms like our main product CityCatalyst . You will work at the intersection of product, data, and program delivery: translating climate goals into engineering tasks, engaging directly with city governments and partners, and shipping with the team. This role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, learns fast, and is comfortable wearing many hats. You will be part of the product team and work directly with the other technical and product team members and a variety of team members in the organization. This position is fully remote and international as our organization works across different time zones. Schedule flexibility is expected with a willingness to collaborate in overlapping core hours for meetings from 8am PST to 11am PST (GMT-8) for org wide meetings and 9am-5pm EST collaboration times for overlap with the product team. Availability to work with overlapping hours across U.S., Latin American and European time zones is preferred. Priority will be given to applications submitted by July 24th. The following requirements describe our ideal candidate. If you don't meet some of the requirements, you're encouraged to apply anyway. Let us know if there is something missing and how we can work together to make it up. Essential Functions and Specific Duties: Own your initiative. Take end-to-end ownership of your initiative within the broader product roadmap — you steer its direction, priorities, and trade-offs, and you keep its backlog groomed and ready for the team. Run delivery. Ensure ticket refining, write user stories, manage backlog, and keep everyone unblocked. Comfortable in Jira, Linear, Notion, or equivalent tools. Keep track of deadlines and delivery. Get hands-on with code. Use AI-assisted tools (vibe coding, Claude Code, Cursor) to prototype, explore, and eventually contribute PRs when needed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to dig in and willing to learn. Face the client. Run demos, workshops, and feedback sessions with city governments and institutional partners. Communicate complex data concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. Work with data. Understand and shape data pipelines, visualizations, and platform architectures. Collaborate with data engineers and scientists on meaningful outputs. Keep learning. Bring intellectual curiosity to every sprint. Explore new tools, frameworks, and approaches, then share what you find with the team. Sweat the details. Hold a high bar for quality and polish. Obsess over the details, catch the rough edges before users do, and care deeply about shipping things that are done right. Other: Actively participate in team building and culture development activities at Open Earth Foundation Qualifications: Proven experience in a product, technical, or delivery role — ideally at a startup or mission-driven tech organization. Ability to translate high-level goals into concrete engineering tasks and track them to completion. Confidence running presentations, client workshops, and stakeholder demos independently. Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day work — whether for writing, prototyping, automation, or research. Curiosity about what's next. Comfort using AI to understand code; willingness to eventually contribute code to the team's codebase. Fluent English (written and spoken) — mandatory. Available to join meetings in US Pacific & Eastern time zone when needed, even if based in a different time zone. Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work in an agile software development environment with a mix of data engineers, full-stack developers, product designers and product managers Ability to estimate and track time worked on tasks Communications skills necessary to document and present work Other Qualities: Dedication to fighting climate change Focus on impact Interest in non-profit work Bias for speed and iteration - you'd rather ship and improve than plan forever Compensation and Benefits: This position is full-time with compensation of $40,000-$55,000/year (USD) , dependent on experience and location (Paid in USD) Open Earth offers unlimited paid time off, paid holidays and paid sick leave You will work remotely within a dynamic and international environment We celebrate our achievements during our annual team retreat OEF is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, religion, national origin, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion in our teams and believe people should align their work with their purpose. Join us if you love Earth. We look forward to hearing from you! We use AI-assisted tools to help organize and summarize application materials. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by people.

title: Senior Product Manager
description: About Apply APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com . LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Latin America , preferably working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone) or ET (Eastern Timezone) . Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees. THE ROLE: Responsibilities Build and champion product strategies and vision throughout client engagements, as well as brief and inspire internal team members to deliver on that vision. Retrieve and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders, other teams, and various research methods, workshop facilitation methodologies to shape requirements, features and end products. Take ownership over creating product plans and roadmaps with the buy-in of executive stakeholders. Prepare and review product requirements documents (PRD) - be meticulous in ensuring requirements of all types (client, business, user experience, design, technical, non-functional) are understood, documented, kept up-to-date, conflicts resolved, and finally communicated in a timely fashion to team members and client stakeholders. Organize product releases and priorities properly, ensuring compliance with business value expectations. Prepare recommendations to track product use and impact end users - define measurement plans for the digital products that we design and build. Build your skills using a repertoire of analytics tools. Ensure requirements have been delivered to specifications, defects have been managed through to resolution, and assess readiness for launch. Continuously prepare recommendations to expand product base and vision - based on data and research-driven insight. Add value to the team - you are not just an order-taker. You understand what it means to drive ROI through business and customer value, you understand the constraints from all directions, and you use your consultative skills to make recommendations to move vision forward. REQUIREMENTS: You are capable of detecting the main projects, initiatives, and epics that must be executed to achieve the expected business results. You are an effective communicator and facilitator, and are able to successfully manage expectations. You are experienced with backlog management, sprint planning, and roadmapping exercises, and you are able to generate spaces and workshops to define approaches and align solutions. You are a creative leader, a team player, and a problem solver. You are professional, confident, and able to understand which ideas will and which won’t work. You have proven yourself in a consultation role, through Agency, Consultancy, or other Professional Services Firm. You have strong proficiency in stakeholder management. Demonstrated experience using Contentful as a headless CMS for building and managing websites is a bonus. You’re good at techie speak and non-techie speak. You’ve collaborated in multidisciplinary teams, are able to convey technical concepts to non-technical people as well as turn business, UX, design requirements into technical specifications. It’s easy for you to break down complex problems into logical, digestible steps Ambiguity doesn’t scare you, and you thrive on turning ambiguity and conflicting information into clarity in a fast-changing environment. You have a portfolio of digital products that you have shipped, managed and operated, and are proud to share how it delivered value to end users. You have done it before, with a minimum of 7 years of experience in a Product Management or similar position. LIFE AT APPLY People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you: Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact. An inclusive and safe environment: We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe. AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work. Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being. Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both. APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Coaching</li><li>Provides executive-level leadership, mentorship, and direct coaching to a team of Managers, ensuring their continuous professional development and capability to lead their respective functional teams (Software Engineers, Product Designers, Delivery Managers, Product Managers, Test Engineers).</li><li>Effectively uses touchpoints (reviews, weekly 1:1s, coaching, feedback) to evolve the skill set of their team, and delivers performance-related feedback within a discipline, to peers, and upward with grace and clarity.</li><li>Approaches all situations (internal and external) with a solutions mindset, coaching teams to focus on what they can do.</li><li>Identifies and contributes to areas of the business that bring additional value, i.e. interviewing, training, contributions to the delivery playbook, etc.</li><li> Strategy &amp; Operational Excellence</li><li>Defines and tracks high-level strategic Delivery and Business value metrics (Rocks and Scorecards) that cascade directly from the Delivery Director’s strategy.</li><li>Provides effective oversight of delivery work, mitigating risk, improving practices, and strengthening client trust.</li><li>Creates clarity with teams through the unique challenges inherent at each stage of client engagements.</li><li>Engages directly with the Triforce/Managers (i.e. attends Triforce meetings regularly) to understand in-flight work, and uses end products where possible to drive performance as part of the team.</li><li> Client &amp; Portfolio Stewardship</li><li>Proactively and organically communicates across client relationships to surface industry thought leadership, best practices, and drive a “doctors not waiters” mentality.</li><li>Coaches Triforces/Managers to understand the client's business drivers, develop relationships, and solve problems.</li><li>Builds client relationships across the executive ladder and regularly conducts Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other meetings to understand feedback, communicate team progress, establish value propositions, and drive change.</li><li> Communication &amp; Influence</li><li>Identifies and influences decisions using reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling.</li><li>Delivers presentations, workshops, and conversations that inspire confidence and influence decisions.</li><li>Navigates high impact and difficult situations with clarity and poise, making decisions that create value for our company and clients.</li><li>Brings energy to moments that matter, particularly new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.</li><li> Technical Leadership &amp; Solution Architecture</li><li>Technical Solution Leadership: Direct the technical definition and architectural design for the most complex client solutions, ensuring long-term viability, scalability, and security.</li><li>Mentorship and Technical Growth: Act as the primary technical mentor for Team Leads and Senior Engineers, elevating the team's technical bar through Deep Dive Sessions, design reviews, and the promotion of best practices.</li><li>Crisis Response (Troubleshooting): Intervene as the top technical expert in projects facing critical technical challenges or production failures to diagnose and define the mitigation plan.</li><li>Technical Pre-Sales: Lead technical conversations with new clients, estimate the technical effort for complex projects, and define the architectural scope for commercial proposals<br><br></li></ul><strong>Internal Applicant Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>An updated resume.</li><li>A one-page cover letter describing why you believe you are qualified for the role, including project contributions and/or prior career experience.</li><li>Identify a function or project manager, or a sponsoring Director who will be detailing and providing a letter of recommendation as to why they are sponsoring your candidacy for this position.<br><br></li></ul>

title: Product Manager - Merchant Experience (Argentina)
description: Job Title: Product Manager - Merchant Experience Location: Remote / Argentina Hiring Manager: Sarah Hill About Sezzle: Sezzle is a cutting-edge fintech company dedicated to financially empowering the next generation. With only one in three millennials owning a credit card and the majority lacking their desired credit scores, Sezzle addresses these challenges through a payment platform that offers interest-free installment plans at online stores. By increasing consumers' purchasing power, Sezzle drives sales and basket sizes for thousands of eCommerce merchants that it partners with. The salary range for this role is $4,000 - $6,000 per month (Gross in USD) About the Role: Sezzle is hiring a Product Manager to own the merchant-facing surfaces of our platform across the US and Canada. The experiences our retail partners use to integrate with Sezzle, manage their accounts, and get paid. You’ll be the sole product owner for merchant sign-up, sign-in, the merchant dashboard, and payouts, working hand-in-glove with our Sales and Business Development teams to turn merchant-acquisition momentum into a product experience that converts, retains, and scales. These are existing products with real usage and real revenue, and they’re ripe for disruption. We’re looking for a PM who sees that as the opportunity, not the obstacle. This role is fully remote, based in Colombia or elsewhere in Latin America, with working hours aligned to US Mountain/Central time (roughly 9am–5pm MT core hours). What you’ll own: You will be the sole PM across the full merchant-account surface: Merchant onboarding — sign-up, KYB collection, underwriting touchpoints, time-to-go-live, activation Merchant authentication — sign-in, SSO, session management, account recovery Merchant dashboard — orders, settlements, reporting, user and role management, self-serve configuration Merchant payouts — payout scheduling, reconciliation, statements, and dispute visibility (with support from adjacent payments and treasury teams on the underlying rails) The merchant-side roadmap — quarterly planning, prioritization, and trade-offs across all four surfaces above Out of scope: consumer-facing surfaces, marketplace and dining partner programs, and merchant geographies outside the US and Canada. How you’ll work — start in Claude, finish in our internal tools: This is a core expectation of the role, not a perk. You’ll use Claude as your default first tool for: Drafting PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria Analyzing merchant funnel data, churn signals, and onboarding drop-off Prototyping flows and UI before formal Design handoff Drafting merchant-facing communications, dashboard copy, and Sales enablement material Researching competitor flows and vendor capabilities Reading code in our GitLab repos and translating engineering changes into product-ready language You’ll then transition that work into our production tools: Jira for tickets and epics, GitLab for code review context, Figma for design handoff, Slack for cross-functional collaboration, and Confluence for documentation. Every PM at Sezzle is expected to operate this way. If you’re not comfortable starting in an AI tool and refining from there, this isn’t the right role for you. Key stakeholders: Engineering and Design — your daily delivery partners Sales (US and Canada) — your primary commercial partner for merchant pipeline, onboarding friction, and merchant retention signal Business Development — for partnership-driven merchant integrations Merchant Operations and Support — for post-launch signal and CX feedback loops Adjacent product and engineering teams — payments, treasury, risk, and platform teams who support the underlying rails behind the merchant surface Integration partners (external) — third-party platforms and providers whose APIs and capabilities power parts of the merchant experience What We Look For: 3–5 years of product management experience shipping B2B or merchant-facing software at a fintech, marketplace, payments, or SaaS company Strong written and spoken English; comfortable leading conversations with US- and Canada-based stakeholders Experience with at least one of: onboarding, dashboard or self-serve admin products, or payments and payouts Familiarity with BNPL, lending, or payments products is a strong plus Working comfort with SQL and the ability to read code (you don’t need to ship it, but you’ll read it) Demonstrated track record of working with Sales and BD as primary commercial partners Adept with AI tools as a daily driver, not a novelty — we encourage candidates to show off their AI workflows in our interview process Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. Compensation Thecompensation for this role is approximately $4,000 - $6,000 USD per month , with clear performance milestones and significant upside for high performers. Our ranges are broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth.

description: <strong>About NCR VOYIX<br><br></strong>NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.<br><br><strong>Product Manager – Software Delivery<br><br></strong><strong>Job Type:</strong> Full-time<br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Buenos Aires<br><br><strong>Position Summary<br><br></strong>We are seeking a <strong> Product Manager – Software Delivery</strong> to lead the development and delivery of digital products and applications. This role is focused on <strong>owning the product vision and managing software development teams</strong>, ensuring high-quality solutions that align with business goals and customer needs.<br><br>The ideal candidate brings strong experience in <strong>software product management</strong>, working closely with engineering teams, and ideally has exposure to <strong>Retail, Restaurant, or Hospitality industries</strong>.<br><br>This is a hands-on role that combines <strong>product ownership, Agile execution, and team leadership</strong> to drive successful product outcomes.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Define and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and priorities.</li><li>Act as the Product Owner, managing the product backlog and ensuring clear, actionable user stories.</li><li>Work closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into product features and requirements.</li><li>Gather and incorporate user feedback and market insights to continuously improve the product.</li><li>Lead and coordinate cross-functional software development teams (engineering, QA, UX/UI).</li><li>Drive end-to-end delivery of digital products and applications using Agile methodologies.</li><li>Ensure efficient sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery execution.</li><li>Monitor timelines, scope, and quality of deliverables.</li><li>Serve as the main point of contact between business, product, and technology teams.</li><li>Align stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.</li><li>Clearly communicate product updates, risks, and progress.</li><li>Track and analyze product performance metrics and KPIs.</li><li>Drive continuous improvement through data-driven decisions.</li><li>Optimize product functionality based on user behavior and business impact.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Required Skills &amp; Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>Proven experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in software development environments.</li><li>Strong background leading or working closely with development teams.</li><li>Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum).</li><li>Ability to manage product backlogs, write user stories, and prioritize effectively.</li><li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.</li><li>Experience delivering digital products or software solutions.</li><li>Advanced English is a must<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience in Retail, Restaurant, or Hospitality industries, especially related to digital or software solutions.</li><li>Familiarity with customer-facing applications, POS systems, or operational platforms.</li><li>Technical understanding of software development processes and systems architecture.</li><li>Experience working in fast-paced, product-driven environments.<br><br></li></ul>Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job<br><br><strong>EEO Statement<br><br></strong>Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.<br><br><strong>Statement to Third Party Agencies<br><br></strong>To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes<br><br><em>“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”</em>

title: Product Manager
description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission We're seeking a talented Product Manager for our growing Professional Services team. The ideal candidate has substantial experience in product management within an application development and engineering services company. Your mission is to drive product success by designing customer-centric product roadmaps, interfacing with UI/UX teams, and managing the ongoing backlog of work that flows to engineering teams. Collaborating closely with our customers, you'll ensure they meet their goals, bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution. Your Assignment Support Customer/User Research and Journey Design Work closely with customers to understand their needs, pain points, and goals. Conduct user research and facilitate journey design workshops to map out the customer journey. Use insights gathered to inform product decisions and ensure alignment with customer expectations. Design Product Roadmaps Create and maintain comprehensive product roadmaps that align with customer business goals and strategic priorities. Set clear product objectives and metrics, and ensure that roadmaps are regularly updated to reflect evolving customer needs and market trends. Ongoing Product Management Manage the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and beyond. Interface with UX teams to ensure that product designs meet user needs and provide a seamless experience. Collaborate with engineering teams to manage the backlog, prioritize features, and ensure timely delivery. Facilitate effective communication between UX and engineering teams to ensure alignment and address any roadblocks promptly. KPIs: Utilization Influenced Pipeline and growth of Customers CSAT scores within Product Engagements Your Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience within application development and engineering services Experience with product roadmap tools and software, running product experiments, and product launches Experience with UX/UI concepts and technologies Experience delivering large, complex consulting engagements for enterprise clients Expertise in product lifecycle management and Agile methodologies Excellent communication skills, especially with executive audiences Startup environment adaptability and cross-functional teamwork Curiosity and eagerness to learn new technologies Willingness to travel for project kick-offs and key client milestones Preferred Qualifications Certifications in AWS, Agile, or related areas Knowledge of Security Best Practices, Cloud Economics, Serverless technologies, container-based architecture, software development frameworks, and cloud cost optimization Experience in AWS consulting with Fortune 2000 clients Benefits Pay in USD 100% remote work Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents Generous holidays and flexible PTO Competitive phantom equity Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture This role may require up to 25% travel, depending on business needs. NOTE: We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship now or at any time in the future. At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements. These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals. If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner. If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com Caylent is a place where everyone belongs . We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

title: Senior Product Owner - CABA, Argentina
description: <p>JR0130472</p><p><br></p><p>As a key member of Western Union’s Product Management team based in Buenos Aires (CABA), this role plays a critical part in driving the development, evolution, and performance of products and services across the Pago Fácil and Western Union ecosystem. The position is responsible for supporting product strategy, identifying new business opportunities, managing the product lifecycle, and delivering commercial initiatives that enhance customer experience, transaction growth, and business profitability. Working cross-functionally with commercial, technology, operations, compliance, and marketing teams, the Assistant Manager will help bring innovative products and services to market while ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Drive the definition and execution of product strategies, roadmaps, and initiatives aligned with business objectives, market opportunities, and customer needs.</li><li>Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, including product development, enhancements, launches, commercialization activities, and continuous improvement efforts.</li><li>Identify growth opportunities through customer, market, industry, and competitive analysis, developing business cases, value propositions, pricing strategies, and recommendations to drive revenue growth.</li><li>Lead cross-functional collaboration with Technology, Operations, Compliance, Marketing, CRM, and Commercial teams to deliver product enhancements, go-to-market initiatives, and strategic projects.</li><li>Monitor product adoption, customer experience, operational performance, and financial results, providing recommendations to optimize outcomes and support profitability objectives.</li><li>Ensure stakeholder alignment and contribute to product governance, regulatory compliance, and the successful execution of product and commercial priorities.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Role Requirements</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is a plus.</li><li>2+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Business Development, Strategy, or related commercial roles supporting product strategy and roadmap execution, with knowledge of product lifecycle management, pricing strategies, customer value proposition development, and go-to-market execution.</li><li>Ability to analyze customer, market, and competitive insights, translate findings into actionable product recommendations, and effectively manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop business cases, support product launches, execute go-to-market initiatives, analyze product financial performance, including P&amp;L considerations, and monitor results through key metrics and KPIs.</li><li>Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Technology, Operations, Commercial, Marketing, and Compliance functions. Experience within financial services, payments, fintech, or related industries is a plus.</li><li>Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across Technology, Operations, Commercial, Marketing, and Compliance functions in financial services, payments, fintech, or related industries.</li><li>Exposure to tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms is a plus. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and API-based integrations is desirable.</li><li>Intermediate English proficiency preferred</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Work Shift</strong></p><p>Western Union values in-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. The expectation is to work from the office a minimum of three days a week.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>BENEFITS AND OTHER DETAILS </strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Benefits</strong></p><p>You will also have access to short-term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and life insurance, and access to best-in-class development platforms, to name a few. Please see the benefits below specific to your country. If applicable, additional role-specific benefits will be mentioned during your interview process or in an offer of employment.</p><p>Specific benefits for Argentina include:</p><ul><li>Marriage and/or birth gift</li><li>Gym membership discounts</li><li>Optional courses (agreements with online universities)</li><li>Gift vouchers for special occasions (Recognition points awarded)</li><li>10 consecutive days of leave for non-birthing parents</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Other Details</strong></p><p>As part of the application process, all applicants are required to take assessments. Western Union has partnered with a 3rd party provider to administer these tests. Applicants will need to provide their name and email address in order to process the assessments. If you have any questions, you may reach out to <u>careers@westernunion.com</u>.</p><p><br></p><p>We are passionate about honoring our employee's identity and fostering a feeling of belonging. Our commitment is to provide an inclusive culture that celebrates the unique backgrounds and perspectives of our global teams while reflecting the communities we serve. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, political affiliation, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status. The company will provide accommodation for applicants, including those with disabilities, during the recruitment process, following applicable laws.</p><p><br></p><p>Estimated Job Posting End Date:</p><p>07-13-2026</p><p>This application window is a good-faith estimate of the time that this posting will remain open. This posting will be promptly updated if the deadline is extended or the role is filled.</p>

description: <br><br><p><strong>Industry/Sector<br></strong>Not Applicable<br><br><p><strong>Specialism<br></strong>IFS - Internal Firm Services - Other<br><br><p><strong>Management Level<br></strong>Manager<br><br><p><strong>Job Description &amp; Summary<br><br></strong>At PwC, our people in risk and compliance focus on maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice, and solutions. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.<br><br>Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:<br><ul><li>Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.</li><li>Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.</li><li>Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.</li><li>Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.</li><li>Effectively mentor others.</li><li>Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members.</li><li>Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.</li><li>Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.</li></ul><ul><li>Product Owners bridge product strategy and technology delivery by translating strategic priorities from Ethics &amp; Compliance leadership into actionable product plans. These roles support the delivery of technology-enabled solutions, operational improvements, and cross-functional initiatives across the firm. As the portfolio of initiatives continues to expand, dedicated Product Owner capacity is required to maintain delivery timelines and support consistent coordination across multiple projects and stakeholders.</li><li>Working closely with Product Managers (e.g., Ethics &amp; Compliance program leaders and SMEs), engineering/development teams, and business stakeholders, Product Owners support planning activities, backlog management, testing and validation processes, and cross-functional coordination that advance initiatives through the product lifecycle.Responsibilities:<br></li></ul>Bridging the Product Manager’s vision with development teams so that the product is built in alignment with strategic priorities; without dedicated product outcomes; without this translation layer, development teams may lack the clarity required to deliver appropriate functionality.<br><br>Continuously reviewing and refining the product backlog with Product Managers to maintain alignment with the product's roadmap and evolving priorities; gaps in this work may lead to inefficient prioritization and slower delivery cycles.<br><br>Facilitating and supporting Business Validation Testing (BVT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm that delivered functionality meets business needs; without coordination, testing cycles may slow or produce Driven by You.<br><br></strong><strong>Total Benefits<br><br></strong>We believe that our employees are our greatest asset, and we're committed to providing them with the resources they need to be successful. If you're looking for a rewarding career with a company that cares about its employees, then Kimberly-Clark is the place for you.<br><br><strong>Flex That Works at Kimberly-Clark <br><br></strong>We believe great work happens when people come together with purpose. That’s why we offer a flexible work model that blends remote work with intentional in-person collaboration — helping you connect, grow, and innovate while maintaining the balance you value.<br><br><strong>To Be Considered<br><br></strong>Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.<br><br>In the meantime, please check out the careers website.<br><br><strong>And finally, the fine print….<br><br></strong>For Kimberly-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers.  When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. description: <p><strong>Quiénes somos</strong></p><p><strong>Acerca de Fudo</strong></p><p>Somos una startup que combina experiencia en la industria gastronómica y pasión por la tecnología. Todos los días ayudamos a miles de restaurantes a lo largo de Latinoamérica a mejorar su servicio gracias a nuestro software de gestión y aplicaciones móviles. Nuestro sistema es líder en Chile y Argentina y estamos creciendo aceleradamente en México, Colombia y Brasil.</p><p><br></p><p>Nuestro mayor propósito es hacerle la vida más fácil a los emprendedores gastronómicos brindándoles las mejores herramientas para llevar adelante sus negocios y, para eso, necesitamos investigar, lanzar productos y llegar a más usuarios de la mano de un gran equipo.</p><p><br></p><p>Cada persona que nos conforma es crucial, por lo que priorizamos generar una cultura basada en la empatía, la transparencia, las ganas y el compromiso.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Acerca del equipo</strong></p><p>El equipo de Producto es un equipo en crecimiento que pertenece al área de Tecnología. de definición, desarrollo y evolución de todas las funcionalidades relacionadas a la vertical de back-office dentro de nuestro software, siendo parte de un equipo multidisciplinario, que incluye personas de Ingeniería y Diseño.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsabilidades del rol</strong></p><ul><li>Liderar el roadmap de las funcionalidades de <em>back-office</em> de la plataforma, transformando la gestión administrativa y financiera de los negocios gastronómicos en una experiencia eficiente y automatizada.</li><li>Identificar oportunidades de producto a través de entrevistas con operadores de restaurantes (dueños, gerentes de local, encargados de cocina) y traducirlas en soluciones concretas dentro del ecosistema Fudo.</li><li>Definir métricas de éxito por feature y hacer seguimiento de adopción — con especial foco en usuarios no técnicos que toman decisiones operativas del día a día.</li><li>Colaborar con equipos de UX, ingeniería, soporte y comercial para entregar funcionalidades que reduzcan la fricción en la operación back-office del restaurante.</li><li>Priorizar el backlog balanceando deuda técnica, necesidades de clientes actuales y oportunidades de expansión de producto.</li><li>Gestionar el ciclo completo de desarrollo: discovery, definición, entrega y medición de impacto.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Experiencia y competencias requeridas</strong></p><ul><li>Experiencia liderando desarrollos de productos tecnológicos.</li><li>Experiencia en productos B2B SaaS, con enfoque en gestión y herramientas de administración</li><li>Experiencia en metodologías ágiles.</li><li>Capacidad de leer y analizar datos de producto de forma autónoma — SQL básico o experiencia con herramientas tipo Metabase, Looker o proyectos.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Requerimientos</strong></p><ul><li>+5 años de experiencia en roles similares</li><li>Carrera de grado o licenciatura (Admin de Empresas, Ingeniería, Marketing)</li><li>Inglés básico.</li><li>Portugués básico deseable.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Beneficios</strong></p><ul><li>Salarios competitivos internacionalmente.</li><li>Opciones en la modalidad de contratación.</li><li>Cobertura de salud dependiendo de la modalidad.</li><li>Trabajo remoto, presencial o mixto.</li><li>Feriados locales + día de cumpleaños libre + días hábiles de vacaciones.</li><li>Capacitación Inglés / Portugués in company.</li><li>Cobertura de Wellhub, para que entrenes cuando y donde sea.</li><li>Beneficios adicionales por partnerships con otras empresas</li></ul>

title: Product Owner Senior
description: En Tecnosoftware nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Product Owner Senior con sólida experiencia en Mercado de Capitales, para incorporarse a un importante proyecto estratégico dentro del sector financiero. MISIÓN DEL ROL El Product Owner (PO) es responsable de maximizar el valor de un producto digital dentro del ecosistema Fintech y de mercado de capitales. Combina visión de negocio, entendimiento profundo del dominio financiero y dominio de prácticas modernas de desarrollo —incluyendo Spec-Driven Development (SDD) y el uso intensivo de Inteligencia Artificial— para acelerar el descubrimiento, la definición y la entrega de soluciones que resuelvan necesidades reales de usuarios e inversores, cumpliendo con los estándares regulatorios y de seguridad del sector. RESPONSABILIDADES Estrategia y Discovery de producto Definir y comunicar una visión de producto clara, alineada al negocio, a los usuarios y a las oportunidades del mercado de capitales. Construir y mantener el roadmap, priorizando por valor, riesgo, esfuerzo y cumplimiento regulatorio. Liderar el discovery continuo: entrevistas, análisis de datos, benchmarking competitivo y validación de hipótesis. Especificación con enfoque SDD (Spec-Driven Development) Traducir necesidades de negocio en especificaciones ejecutables, precisas y versionadas, que funcionen como única fuente de verdad para el equipo y para agentes de IA. Escribir criterios de aceptación, reglas de negocio y edge cases con el nivel de detalle que exige un producto financiero (por ej. cálculo de PPC/WAC, valuación, márgenes, settlement). Mantener las specs vivas y trazables durante todo el ciclo, asegurando que el desarrollo —con o sin asistencia de IA— refleje fielmente la intención. IA como palanca de productividad y de producto Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar research, síntesis de feedback, generación y refinamiento de historias/specs, prototipado y análisis de datos. Identificar y priorizar oportunidades de incorporar IA en el producto (asistentes, automatizaciones, scoring, detección de anomalías, etc.). Evaluar críticamente los outputs de IA: validar exactitud, sesgos, seguridad y cumplimiento antes de llevarlos a producción. Delivery y colaboración con el equipo Gestionar y priorizar el backlog garantizando un flujo de trabajo claro y sin bloqueos. Colaborar estrechamente con desarrollo, QA, diseño, riesgos y compliance para asegurar entregas de calidad. Participar activamente en las ceremonias ágiles y remover impedimentos. Datos, métricas y cumplimiento Definir métricas de éxito (North Star, KPIs de negocio y de producto) y monitorear su evolución. Tomar decisiones basadas en datos y en resultados de experimentos (A/B testing). Asegurar que el producto cumpla requisitos regulatorios, de seguridad y de auditoría del sector financiero. Gestión de stakeholders Comunicar visión, avances y trade-offs a áreas de negocio, tecnología y gerencia. Alinear expectativas y negociar prioridades con transparencia. CONOCIMIENTOS REQUERIDOS Metodologías y prácticas modernas Metodologías ágiles: Scrum, Kanban. Spec-Driven Development (SDD): escritura de especificaciones claras, testeables y aptas para desarrollo asistido por IA. Gestión de producto: estrategia, priorización, roadmapping y discovery. Inteligencia Artificial aplicada Uso de asistentes de IA (LLMs) para productividad y para el proceso de producto. Nociones de prompt engineering y evaluación crítica de outputs. Comprensión general de capacidades y límites de la IA (deseable: GenAI, RAG, agentes). Dominio Fintech / Mercado de Capitales Instrumentos y operatoria: renta fija/variable, FX, derivados, FCI, cauciones. Procesos: pricing/valuación, liquidación (settlement), custodia, reporting y P&L. Marco regulatorio y de compliance (deseable: CNV, BCRA, PLA/FT, seguridad de la información). Técnicos de producto Definición y documentación de requisitos, historias de usuario y criterios de aceptación. Principios de UX/UI (deseable Figma). Análisis de datos para la toma de decisiones. HABILIDADES Y COMPETENCIAS Pensamiento crítico: capacidad de cuestionar propuestas de forma constructiva y proponer alternativas superadoras. Comunicación clara adaptada a distintas audiencias (técnicas y de negocio). Priorización y toma de decisiones bajo incertidumbre. Colaboración y liderazgo sin autoridad formal. Orientación a datos y a resultados. Aprendizaje continuo y adaptabilidad ante mercados y tecnologías cambiantes. Atención al detalle y rigurosidad, crítica en productos financieros. HERRAMIENTAS Gestión de producto y backlog: Jira, Confluence, Trello / Linear. IA y productividad: ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot y herramientas de SDD (deseable: Cursor, GitHub Spec Kit o similares). Comunicación: Slack, Zoom, Google Meet. Diseño: Figma (deseable, no excluyente). Analítica de datos: Google Analytics / Tag Manager / Looker Studio / SQL (deseable, no excluyente). EXPERIENCIA Experiencia comprobable como Product Owner o rol similar (excluyente). Experiencia trabajando con metodologías ágiles (excluyente). Experiencia en productos digitales, idealmente en Fintech, banca o mercado de capitales (altamente valorada). Experiencia utilizando IA en el flujo de trabajo de producto (diferencial). COMPETENCIAS PERSONALES Orientación al cliente y al negocio. Pensamiento estratégico y crítico. Liderazgo e influencia. Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad. Autonomía y proactividad. Motivación por el logro y resiliencia en entornos desafiantes. Modalidad hibrida, asistencia 2 o 3 veces por semana en Retiro, CABA. Beneficios Relación de dependencia con Tecnosoftware. Prepaga Swiss Medical Group para grupo familiar primario (hasta 3 cápitas). Día libre de cumpleaños. Medio día libre por cumpleaños de hijo/a. Reintegro del 50% en vacunación de mascotas. Descuentos en UADE, UAI y Universidad Siglo XXI. Descuentos en Educación IT y CUI. Beneficios en BGH, Sony y Finaer.

title: Product Owner - Data Intelligence
description: The job can be based in Poland, Portugal or Agentina. MAKE HISTORY WITH US At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on smoke-free products with the power to deliver a smoke-free future. With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and you will have the space to move your career forward in many different areas/directions. The Product Owner - Data Intelligence Platform is accountable for the vision, roadmap and maximizing business value from the platforms enabling Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Advanced AI/ML capabilities across the company. The role owns what problems are worth solving, why they matter, and how platform capabilities translate into measurable outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of business demand, technology, governance, and adoption, ensuring that investment in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Advanced Analytics results in real customer value, responsible scale, and sustainable cost and risk management. The Product Owner acts as a steward of value and a strategic integrator, ensuring teams focus on well-defined, high‑impact problems while avoiding misaligned use cases and uncontrolled experimentation, and while effectively managing and collaborating with stakeholders. Product Scope The role owns the product vision and value delivery for PMI’s Data Intelligence platform, including: Generative AI Platforms - enterprise LLM access (AWS Bedrock, Gemini and Azure), GenAI APIs, knowledge bases, guardrails. GenAI Playgrounds – Custom inhouse development solutions to promote AI fluency within the company. Agentic AI Enablement LangSmith, LangGraph, Databricks, AgentCore – runtime, observability, and evaluation of agent-based workflows. Advanced Analytics & AI/ML Platforms Databricks, Amazon SageMaker – end to end platform for model development, training, deployment, MLOps, and governance These platforms are treated as enterprise products—designed for reuse, scale, governance, and long‑term business impact. JOIN US WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 4+ years in Product Management / Product Ownership, preferably for platforms Proven experience with GenAI, AI/ML, or advanced analytics ecosystems Strong background in Agile, product‑centric operating models Solid understanding of: Generative AI and LLM ecosystems Agentic AI and orchestration patterns AI/ML lifecycle, AIOps and MLOps Working knowledge of GenAI, Agentic AI, ML technologies (i.e. AWS Bedrock, GCP, Azure, AWS Sagemaker, Databricks, OpenAI, Langchain) Understanding of IT Platform building principles (Microservices Architecture, CI/CD, Scalability, multitenancy) Comfortable operating in large, regulated enterprise environments Strong understanding of Agile principles and practices, particularly in the context of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Scrum and Kanban Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize and make trade-offs based on business value WHAT WE OFFER YOU? Our Success Depends On The Men And Women Who Come To Work Every Single Day With a Sense Of Purpose And An Appetite For Progress. Join PMI And You Too Can Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment, and explore. Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong. Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress. Take pride in delivering our promise to society to deliver a smoke-free future. In case of being hired in Poland in this position you will earn no less than PLN 21 800 gross per month HOW CAN YOU MAKE HISTORY WITH US? Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog with explicit linkage to business outcomes, value realization, adoption, and customer satisfaction Prioritize initiatives based on expected value, strategic relevance, feasibility, and risk, continuously challenging solution‑first thinking with clear problem statements and success criteria Represent the needs of business users, data scientists, engineers, and platform consumers, ensuring platforms remove friction and enable meaningful outcomes Drive structured feedback loops (user engagement, NPS/CSAT, usage data) and translate insights into evidence‑based roadmap decisions Act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, translating complex technical or regulatory constraints into clear, decision‑ready trade‑offs and managing cross‑team dependencies Lead the evolution of secure, scalable, and compliant platforms, embedding Responsible AI, security, privacy, and compliance by design Embrace continuous discovery and problem framing, validating who benefits, how success is measured, and whether a platform solution is justified before scaling Partner with engineering to ensure high‑quality delivery, transparent governance, KPI tracking (value, usage, cost), and clear communication of progress, risks, and decisions Please note that only on-line applications will be taken into consideration. Each person who sends the application will receive information about its status. Relocation support is not available. At PMI we run the business in line with ethical principles and encourage SpeakUp culture. We care for equal chances and fair treatment. If you find anything that violates these principles in this job offer or the recruitment process, you may contact our Ethics and Compliance Team at PMIEthicsandCompliance@pmi.com . Read more about Ethics&Compliance at PMI – here. 27040

title: Product Manager, Laravel Cloud
description: Laravel is the most popular PHP framework in the world. 500M+ lifetime downloads. Thousands of packages. A developer community that shows up — at conferences, in forums, on Twitter, in Discord servers, and in every "what framework should I use?" thread on the internet. But Laravel is more than a framework. It is a complete ecosystem with dedicated tools and resources to help you go from building an app locally to deploying it, monitoring usage, and then improving and scaling it up. Laravel Cloud is the platform at heart of it all: a fully managed home for web apps, with managed compute, databases, caches, object storage, WebSockets, queues, and built-in scale-to-zero with millisecond wakes that keeps idle infrastructure from breaking the budget. We're early. Laravel Cloud is growing fast, the roadmap is wide open, and the decisions we make now will shape the product for years. There is no 50-page process doc and no layer of approvals between you and shipping. What there is: incredible product-market fit, a brand that opens every door, and a small team of people who care deeply about doing this right. We're looking for a Product Manager to help us build it. Why this role is unique You are building infrastructure for developers with strong, informed opinions and a low tolerance for inauthenticity Earning technical credibility matters, even if you are not an engineer — you'll be making product calls about compute, databases, and scaling You own a real slice of the product end to end and operate in real ambiguity, helping define what Laravel Cloud becomes Product is a team sport here. Engineering, design, and marketing are true partners What you will do Own products end-to-end. Take an area of Laravel Cloud from conception to launch — discovery, prioritization, and shipping — and know it better than anyone in the company Partner closely with engineering. Define scope and appetite together with engineering, bringing the why, the who, and the when while the team owns the how Stay close to customers. Talk to customers regularly — enterprise calls, community signal, direct interviews — and let what you learn drive prioritization Be data-driven on outcomes. "We shipped it" isn't the finish line — adoption is. Track how features are adopted and used, and prioritize based on what the data says Be the connective tissue. Brief marketing and sales ahead of launches and own the holistic experience, so your area feels coherent, not just complete What the ideal candidate brings Good taste and a high craft bar. You have opinions about what makes product feel right and defend them, holding design and engineering to a high standard Focus on what matters. Comfortable juggling several projects at once, with ruthless prioritization and clear async communication Competitive awareness. You know the landscape cold — Heroku, Vercel, Railway, Render, Fly — and what good looks like on observability, deploy ergonomics, and billing transparency Technical curiosity. Learns infrastructure concepts proactively to maintain credibility with technical audiences Customer-first, collaborative DNA. Strong cross-functional partnerships, with a focus on developer value over shipping features Comfort with early-stage ambiguity. Enjoys experimentation and iteration, and building the plane while flying it What success looks like Velocity. You ship fast and on time — speed is core to how we work, and PMs have outsized impact on it Quality. You ship with the level of quality synonymous with Laravel, scoping with engineering so work lands well the first time Outcomes. Your area is adopted and your customers are satisfied — not just launched Requirements Minimum qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 4 years of experience in product management or a related technical role 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (0 to 1, ideation through execution) Experience developing or launching infrastructure products or technologies — compute, databases, storage, networking, file systems, or other software infrastructure Preferred qualifications Experience with cloud, platform-as-a-service, or developer-tools products Familiarity with Laravel, PHP, or modern web application development Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, and other stakeholders Comfort working closely with engineering to shape scope, in a fast-moving, async-first environment Background in software development or engineering Benefits Fully remote, globally distributed team Option to attend Laracon conferences around the world Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, public holidays) Family leave (maternity, paternity) Company equity Access to high quality training tools to ensure you are enabled to be the best you can be Welcome kit with custom Laravel swag
